summary_en: Understanding the natural testosterone decline with age, what is normal, and what you can do.
summary_fr: Comprendre le declin naturel de la testosterone avec l'age, ce qui est normal et ce que vous pouvez faire.
body_en:
Testosterone levels in men begin a gradual decline starting around age 30, decreasing at an average rate of approximately 1 to 2 percent per year. This process, sometimes referred to as andropause or late-onset hypogonadism, was quantified in the landmark Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging and confirmed by the Massachusetts Male Aging Study (MMAS), which followed over 1,700 men for nearly a decade. By age 70, the average man's testosterone level is approximately 35 to 40 percent lower than at age 30. However, there is enormous individual variation: some men maintain robust testosterone levels well into their 70s, while others experience significant decline by their 40s.

The decline is not solely driven by aging itself. Lifestyle factors accelerate or decelerate testosterone loss substantially. Obesity is perhaps the single strongest modifiable predictor of low testosterone: adipose tissue contains aromatase enzymes that convert testosterone to estradiol, creating a self-reinforcing cycle of declining androgens and increasing body fat. The MMAS data showed that a 4-5 point increase in BMI was associated with a decline in testosterone equivalent to 10 years of aging. Physical inactivity, poor sleep quality, chronic stress, excessive alcohol consumption, and nutrient deficiencies (particularly zinc and vitamin D) all independently contribute to accelerated decline.

The question of when age-related testosterone decline becomes clinically meaningful is the subject of ongoing medical debate. Current guidelines from the Endocrine Society define male hypogonadism as total testosterone consistently below 300 ng/dL combined with symptoms such as reduced energy, diminished libido, difficulty concentrating, depressed mood, and loss of muscle mass. Importantly, symptoms do not correlate perfectly with laboratory values: some men are symptomatic at 350 ng/dL while others feel fine at 250 ng/dL. This is why tracking your subjective daily metrics in Flux provides valuable longitudinal data that complements periodic blood work, helping you and your healthcare provider make informed decisions about your hormonal health.
body_fr:
Les niveaux de testosterone chez les hommes commencent un declin progressif a partir d'environ 30 ans, diminuant a un taux moyen d'environ 1 a 2 pour cent par an. Ce processus, parfois appele andropause ou hypogonadisme a debut tardif, a ete quantifie dans la celebre Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging et confirme par la Massachusetts Male Aging Study (MMAS), qui a suivi plus de 1 700 hommes pendant pres d'une decennie. A 70 ans, le niveau moyen de testosterone d'un homme est environ 35 a 40 pour cent plus bas qu'a 30 ans. Cependant, il existe une enorme variation individuelle : certains hommes maintiennent des niveaux de testosterone robustes bien dans leurs 70 ans, tandis que d'autres connaissent un declin significatif des leurs 40 ans.

Le declin n'est pas uniquement du au vieillissement lui-meme. Les facteurs de style de vie accelerent ou decelerent la perte de testosterone de maniere substantielle. L'obesite est peut-etre le plus fort predicteur modifiable de testosterone basse : le tissu adipeux contient des enzymes aromatase qui convertissent la testosterone en estradiol, creant un cycle auto-renforçant de declin des androgenes et d'augmentation de la graisse corporelle. Les donnees MMAS ont montre qu'une augmentation de 4-5 points de l'IMC etait associee a un declin de testosterone equivalent a 10 ans de vieillissement.

La question de savoir quand le declin de testosterone lie a l'age devient cliniquement significatif fait l'objet d'un debat medical en cours. Les directives actuelles de l'Endocrine Society definissent l'hypogonadisme masculin comme une testosterone totale constamment inferieure a 300 ng/dL combinee a des symptomes tels que reduction de l'energie, diminution de la libido, difficulte de concentration, humeur depressive et perte de masse musculaire. Fait important, les symptomes ne sont pas parfaitement correles avec les valeurs de laboratoire. C'est pourquoi le suivi de vos metriques subjectives quotidiennes dans Flux fournit des donnees longitudinales precieuses qui completent les bilans sanguins periodiques, vous aidant ainsi que votre professionnel de sante a prendre des decisions eclairees.
